title: Contrastboard: per-model/route latency breakdown (p50/p95/p99) with streaming vs non-streaming cohorts
creator: Aisha Mahmood
description:
Purpose: Build a new observability dashboard ("Contrastboard") that surfaces latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) per model and per route with an explicit breakdown between streaming and non-streaming IO paths. The board should make it easy to spot divergence between streaming vs non-streaming tails for the same model/route, and provide trace-hooks and drilldowns to follow tails to traces and logs.

Why now: Multiple incidents and support tickets have highlighted situations where streaming responses show higher tail latency even when sync p95 looks healthy. Current dashboards mix IO modes and make correlation slow. This work combines trace hook coverage, metrics enrichment, and new dashboard visualizations so SREs, product engineers, and model owners can quickly identify degradation vectors and actionable mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exists with per-model + per-route rows and selectable timeframe (1h, 6h, 24h, 7d)
Panels show p50/p95/p99 token and request latency for streaming and non-streaming separately
Delta panel that computes streaming_p95 - nonstream_p95 and flags positive deltas > 100ms
Each percentile datapoint links to sample traces via trace ID and shows top 3 correlated error/log signatures
Trace sampling updated to ensure 100% sampling for p99 tail-bound traces for 1% of traffic in production for first two weeks of rollout
Automated alert rule created: streaming_p99 > baseline OR delta_p95 > 100ms sustained for 5m -> Pager severity P2
Dashboard supports cohort filters: model family, route path, region, customer tier (hosted/dedicated/private)
Regression test that asserts dashboard metrics match offline aggregation for a synthetic replay of 100k requests
technical_notes: Metrics pipeline change: add 'io_mode' tag to latency histogram and request duration spans (values: streaming, nonstreaming)
Log enrichment: attach route and model metadata at ingress (route_id, model_id, model_variant, request_shape_tag)
Tracing: add trace hooks at streaming frontier to record streaming start/finish and total tokens emitted; mark span.kind=server and span.subtype=streaming when streaming path used
Storage: histogram rollup at 1s resolution for last 24h and 1m resolution for 7d to prevent blowup; use pre-aggregated quantiles where possible
Query engine: precompute p50/p95/p99 by (model_id, route_id, io_mode) and store as metric series for dashboard fast reads
Sampling policy: boosted tail sampling (tagged 'latency_tail=true') and a short-lived trace-forwarder to retain full traces for tail investigations
Backfill: run a job to backfill io_mode for last 14 days for routes instrumented already to seed the dashboard
telemetry_queries: Delta calc: p95_delta = p95_streaming - p95_nonstreaming -> annotate when p95_delta > 0.1
Tracing: SELECT traces WHERE duration_ms >= percentile(duration_ms, 99) AND tags.io_mode=\"streaming\" LIMIT 50
Log correlation: top 10 error signatures for traces in the selected time window grouped by exception.type and message fingerprint
dashboard_panels: Overview heatmap: rows=model_id, cols=route_id, cell color=p95_streaming (hover shows p50/p95/p99 for both modes)
Split-time series: small-multiples per model with streaming vs nonstreaming p95 lines and shaded p50/p99 bands
Delta waterfall: bar chart of p95 deltas ordered by magnitude (positive deltas at top)
Tail table: top 50 traces contributing to p99 with links to trace view and most frequent log signature per trace
Cohort slicer: dropdowns to filter by region, customer_tier, model_variant, request_shape
Anomaly markers: show incidents correlated with infra events (GPU preemption, kernel OOM) from event stream
rollout_plan: Week 0: implement metric tagging and tracing hooks in canary service; run in eu-west-1 canary with 5% traffic
Week 1: enable boosted tail sampling and dashboard read-only for SREs; begin backfill job for 14d
Week 2: open dashboard to product and model owners; collect feedback and iterate panels
Week 3: enable alerting rules and schedule a runbook walkthrough with oncall; expand rollout to all regions
Rollback: remove io_mode tag ingestion and revert sampling policy if noise or cardinality issues observed
testing_plan: Unit tests for metric enrichment and histogram tagging
Integration test: simulate streaming vs nonstreaming flows and assert percentile separation in test cluster
Staging smoke: deploy to staging and validate dashboard panels show expected values from synthetic workload
Load test: verify metrics pipeline handles additional cardinality and compute pre-aggregation latency under production-like load
Post-deploy: 48h monitoring window for metric cardinality, storage growth, and alert noise rate
